items.text: Elcogen (priority stack):* No new company news in the window — direct fetch of elcogen.com/category/news confirms the Sept 21, 2026 Metrosert testing-cooperation announcement remains the latest post (full recent history checked back to the Sept 15 Shanghai HyEnergy item and Aug 31 China Southern Power Grid MoU; no capacity, product, or partnership news since).

Topsoe (priority stack):* No new company news in the window — topsoe.com/news still lists the H1 2026 half-year results (DKK ~4.4bn special-items charge, upward full-year guidance revision) and the Uniper e-methanol FEED contract as the most recent dated items. No new SOEC/SOFC test result, factory milestone, or partnership identified.

Rotating benchmark-company dedicated searches (this cycle: Sunfire, SolydEra/SOLIDpower, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC), 7-day lookback:* No new items within the window for any of the six. Sunfire's name collided heavily with wildfire-season search noise (no company-specific results surfaced at all). SolydEra/Solid Power results were dominated by its Q2 2026 results (already stale, reported Aug 4). Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera and Aisin searches surfaced only recycled 2025-dated SEO strategy writeups (enkiai.com) and legacy residential-cogeneration releases, no 2026 company news. Chaozhou Three-Circle (CCTC) surfaced only its Wikipedia profile and old (2013-era) investor coverage — no recent SOFC-specific activity found for this Chinese ceramics/electronic-components group.

Other key players (Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power):* No new stack/cell-technology-specific announcements identified in the window beyond items already logged in prior entries (financial/market news for all three covered below).

No change* since yesterday. Germany's Netzpaket Bundestag plenary vote remains targeted around Oct 16 (5 days out); no published committee outcome located. PJM's 6 GW data-center backstop capacity procurement remains unfiled with FERC following the Sept 29 suspension order. No change on: Germany's KWK-Gesetz cabinet consideration (Oct 14, 3 days out); DOE/FERC large-load interconnection rulemaking (Apr 30, 2026 deadline); ITC 48E and 45V hydrogen credit status (no new IRS/Treasury guidance found); Virginia's fuel-cell-specific 2026 Energy Plan category and data-center electricity tax (confirmed unchanged — the Oct 1 SELC press release and related coverage describe the already-logged energy-affordability/data-center-tax package, no new provision); EU data-centre energy/water-efficiency reporting rules; UK Ofgem's data-centre grid-connection-queue reform consultation; Ireland's data-centre grid-connection rules.
